title: Chili-Lime Tilapia Tacos
steps:
425°F. Roast corn
+ sliced peppers
for 5 minutes

Rub the fish with chili,
garlic + lime zest. Onto
the pan for 8-10 min

Squeeze on lime.
Flake into tortillas,
top with avocado
vo: One pan, dinner in twenty-five minutes.
Sheet pan chili lime tilapia tacos.
You need tilapia, frozen corn, two bell peppers, chili powder, limes, tortillas and an avocado.
Heat the oven to four twenty-five, and roast the corn and sliced peppers for five minutes.
Rub the fish with chili powder, garlic and lime zest, then roast it on the same pan for eight to ten minutes.
Squeeze lime over everything, flake the fish into warm tortillas, and top with avocado.
